notes: Badges for the Wall of Wins, in display order. type: habitStreak (best current streak across your habits, in days) | habitTotal (sum of a habit's logged values; per divides it, e.g. 60 turns minutes into hours) | noFoodStreak (days in a row with no food delivery expense) | savingsTotal (rupees across savings goals) | milestones (goal milestones completed). A badge is earned when its value reaches target; it's then saved to ascend:wins with that day's date.

badges.name: 7-day streak
badges.desc: Keep any habit 7 days in a row.
badges.cheer: A full week without a break. That’s a habit forming.

badges.name: 30-day streak
badges.desc: Keep any habit 30 days in a row.
badges.cheer: A whole month, every single day. That’s who you are now.

badges.name: 100-day streak
badges.desc: Keep any habit 100 days in a row.
badges.cheer: 100 days. Most people never get here. You did.

badges.name: 365-day streak
badges.desc: Keep any habit every day for a year.
badges.cheer: A full year without a break. Legendary.

badges.name: 100 DSA problems
badges.cheer: 100 problems solved. Interviews just got less scary.

badges.name: 500 study hours
badges.cheer: 500 hours of ISS. That’s the work that clears exams.

badges.name: 30 days, no delivery
badges.desc: Go 30 days in a row without ordering food delivery.
badges.cheer: 30 days of home food. Your wallet and your body both say thanks.

badges.name: First ₹10,000 saved
badges.cheer: Your first ₹10,000 set aside. The first one is the hardest.

badges.name: First milestone
badges.cheer: Your first flag on the mountain. Many more to plant.
